title: Each redraw pushes a full 40-row frame into terminal scrollback
observed: kiln runs with AltScreen=true (app.go:1053), yet iTerm2 scrollback grows by exactly one full screen per state change: 40→80→120→160→200→240 rows after four shift+tab presses; each saved frame is a complete kiln screen. Scrolling up in the terminal shows a stack of stale kiln frames.
expected: Redraws on the alternate screen leave terminal scrollback untouched; only the diffed cells are rewritten.

fix.note: Root cause: the vendored full-redraw patch cleared the screen on every changed frame; iTerm2 archives any clear from home. Alt screen now uses the incremental diff. Scrollback 0 after two mode changes (was +40 rows each). Other terminals still to verify.
